reviews.title: They are tricking people
reviews.text: When you open the app for the first time it talks about their privacy policy and you can opt in or opt out. The slider is already colored in as if it’s checked to opt out already but the dot is in the off position. So it looks like you’re already opting out from them collecting sensitive data and reselling it. But you have to check the slider and turn it on, but when you turn it on it stay highlighted. So no matter if it’s off or on it stays highlighted so people can think they are good when they actually are agreeing to have the personal phone data taken and sold. Plus they want $9.99 a week😂 scam all day.

reviews.title: $9.99 a WEEK???
reviews.text: I spent an hour scanning 72 pages and formatting them, just to find out that I have to pay $9.99 just to export that one large document? First of all, it was a huge waste of time, and second, the app doesn’t even work that well. Within five pages, it was slowing down and glitching out. I was worried I was going to have to start again, but the app subscription price did that for me. CamScanner literally only charges a dollar a month, and you can still export documents just with a small watermark. $40 a month for pdf scanning is absolute robbery. Never buy this app.

reviews.title: Double charge and no option to cancel
reviews.text: I got this app a long while ago. Realized I was being double charged for the same account (at first I thought maybe it was someone in my shared family account who also got the subscription). Both of the subscriptions had my email. Canceled because I no longer needed it. Well, the app subscription shows as canceled in my settings, but I just got charged again. I’ve tried to contact support but no success. Am I condemned to paying 5 dollars a month forever, for no service? This is a scam.

reviews.title: Keeps charging fee
reviews.text: I’m very angry. I cancelled this two days into the trial period. Dec 18 was the end of it, I have the confirmation email and it’s no longer in Apple subscriptions. Yesterday 12/22 they charged me their “weekly rate”. I go in to the app and it tells me I have no active subscriptions and offers me to restart the trial. I contacted Apple and they’re saying it’s not eligible for a refund. Idk how to get these charges stopped. Don’t give them your card info!
